name: Kikunoi Honten
dinnerNote: Kaiseki course (others from ¥22,000); including tax, service extra
dinnerNoteJa: 懐石コース（他に22,000円のコースあり）・税込・サービス料別
lunchNote: Lunch kaiseki, from; including tax, service extra
lunchNoteJa: 昼懐石（最安値）・税込・サービス料別

menus.name: kaiseki course
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; also at ¥55,000, ¥77,000 and ¥110,000; tax included, 15% service extra

menus.name: lighter kaiseki course
menus.note: Fewer dishes; lunch or dinner; tax included, 15% service extra

menus.name: lunch kaiseki
menus.note: The shortest course, lunch only (arrive 12pm to 12:30pm); tax included, 15% service extra

alsoTry.name: Salon de Muge
alsoTry.note: Kikunoi's casual café next door to the main restaurant: the Shigure bento at lunch (11:30am to 1pm, bookable) plus a ¥1,650 seating charge, and coffee and warabimochi in the afternoon (walk-in only)

bookingOpens: By phone (10am to 10pm, except on closing days) or email (honten@kikunoi.co.jp). Guests from outside Japan book online through My Concierge Japan, the restaurant's official booking partner, paying in advance.
groups: Ten private tatami rooms over two floors take parties of 2 to 40.
dressCode: Smart casual. No beach sandals, sportswear, T-shirts, vests or shorts, and no strong perfume. Shoes come off at the entrance, so bring socks or stockings.
children: Children aged 8 and over who can eat the adult course; no children under 8.
